## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `lineage-relevance-continuity`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-13T17:50:01.162Z.

Planning pass 2026-07-13 (directed maintainer pass, continuation): Algorithm (22) lineage-aware relevance continuity — identity flow across copy/split/merge/supersede. Purpose: decades of restructuring fragment identity — items get copied (pm copy is a first-class verb and already stamps copied_from=<id> into the history message, deterministic provenance in the episodic stream), split into slices, folded into epics, closed-as-superseded and re-filed. Raw per-item signals treat each fragment as a stranger: a predecessor's decade of activation, outcomes, and precedent value is invisible from its successor, so precisely the oldest, most-restructured knowledge — the decades pole of the directive — scores worst. Optimal context must follow the WORK, not the row id. Cognitive analog: object continuity / identity tracking — episodes bind to the persisting entity across renames and transformations, not to its surface label. Part 1 — lineage edges as first-class typed edges: copied_from (promote the existing history-message stamp to a structured edge at write time), split_from/split_into, merged_into, superseded_by at ITEM level (deliberately the same relation vocabulary as pm-vvib's belief-level supersedes on decisions/learnings — same shape, different corpus; coordination, not duplication). Where explicit edges are missing across legacy decades, mine advisory candidates from close-reason cross-references and title/body similarity at close/create adjacency in the episodic stream — reusing pm-4ri6's hybrid-similarity machinery with a different edge kind, always advisory and confirmable, never auto-linked. Part 2 — relevance mass flow: terminal lineage events transfer a kind-specific fraction of folded activation/affinity to the successor at fold time (6) (merge = capped sum, split = weighted partition, copy = small fraction since the source lives on, supersede = large fraction + tombstone pointer); spreading activation (2) traverses lineage edges with kind-specific damping so residual ancestor mass stays reachable; precedent assembly (10)/(12) collapses a lineage chain into ONE episode — the chain IS the story (filed -> split -> superseded -> done) — instead of k fragmented weak matches; packing (4) treats lineage-mates as near-duplicates so only the best representative spends budget, carrying a lineage breadcrumb for drill-down. Part 3 — identity-collapsed statistics: (21)'s hierarchical priors and (12)'s outcome statistics aggregate over the lineage-collapsed entity (evidence counts sum along the chain), so successors inherit calibrated history instead of restarting at the prior. Spectrum behavior: small/young workspaces have no lineage — zero edges, zero cost, zero behavior change; decades-deep archives get their restructuring history turned from a scoring liability into connective structure; cost is O(lineage events) at fold time and chain collapse is bounded by (2)'s damped hop limit, disclosed. Distinct from pm-g5sx (VCS-branch merging of tracker store files — mechanical JSONL merge safety; this is semantic item identity across time within one store), from vvib's supersedes relation (belief currency for decisions/learnings; this is item-level relevance mass — shared vocabulary by design), from (2) alone (proximity scoring; this adds mass TRANSFER and episode COLLAPSE, not just traversal), from (15) (representation of one item; this is identity across items), and from pm-4ri6 (create-time duplicate prevention; the mining here is post-hoc lineage recovery on the same machinery). Ownership: lineage edge kinds + traversal = design constraint on the pm-801d read index (edge-kind vocabulary must be extensible — recorded there BEFORE implementation); fold-side mass transfer + collapsed statistics = pm-3hps (wave 3); packing dedupe/breadcrumb = pm-55ra; the structured copied_from/superseded_by write-time stamps land with the mutating verbs, sequenced with the wave-3 fold.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
